Dequantization, however, is embarrassingly parallel in principle — every 4-bit value can be decoded independently of all the others — and the per-block loop hides that parallelism behind a queue of small sequential launches; the fused kernel instead issues one launch whose threads map one-to-one onto every packed pair of FP4 values across the whole cache window, presenting the entire workload to the GPU at once.
